# Coming soon

<!-- generated by scripts/render_entities_doc.py; do not hand edit -->

What a step can say it `builds` but the engine cannot build yet. Snapshot of `intempt/llm-wrapper@16c2a7a2 src/blu_chat/sevices/recipes/md_import.py ALLOWED_ENTITIES`.

Each one waits on the same thing: a builder for it in the engine's recipe allowlist. Until then a step that builds it keeps its real `builds` value, and the recipe is Coming soon and names it in `waitingOn`.

Recipes waiting: recipes in this repo that need the builder. Only blocker for: recipes that need nothing else, and flip to Install now the day it ships.

## Writing a step for one of these

Write it to the same bar as an Install now step: one thing, every value written out, earlier steps by title with `dependsOn`. It will run unchanged when the builder ships. Say in the conversation that it is waiting, and never swap in an Install now entity that does something different. [../../NO-ENTITY-EXISTS.md](../../NO-ENTITY-EXISTS.md) has the jobs people ask for most and what to do instead.

When the engine adds a builder, move its row from `COMING_SOON_ENTITIES` to `BUILDABLE_ENTITIES` in `scripts/recipe_contract.py`, re-run `scripts/render_entities_doc.py`, and add the entity to a family page in [README.md](README.md).
